planets.name: TOI-784 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 307842 with a 2.8-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-784 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 307842. Its orbit and size follow Hua et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
